current_difficulty_reason: The Casimir equation must first be converted into a forced ODE for renormalized horocycle integrals with uniform control of the forcing. The source identifies global coefficient integrals and tracks the two complementary-series exponents while estimating the tail to obtain the inverse-time remainder and explicit average bound. It then controls anisotropic geodesic expansion inside those coefficient integrals to prove the exact Holder exponents, a substantive dynamics obligation beyond solving a scalar constant-coefficient ODE.
